   gyms: { regionsOf(gymId: number): string[] },
diff --git a/src/services/train-service.spots.test.ts b/src/services/train-service.spots.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..5baccd083e9b092dae82dc40e33039661a70f4f2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/services/train-service.spots.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,147 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { EAST_CHANNEL } from '../../test/support/gyms.js';
+import { customIdsOf, textOf } from '../../test/support/messages.js';
+import { ALICE, gym } from '../../test/support/parties.js';
+import { createdTrain } from '../../test/support/party-service.js';
+import { gymsFixture } from '../../test/support/providers.js';
+import { keptRow } from '../../test/support/wayspot-cases.js';
+import { wayspotsWith } from '../../test/support/wayspots.js';
+import { selectsOf } from '../../test/support/messages.js';
+import { spotStop } from '../domain/party/stops.js';
+import { trainPanel } from '../render/train-panel.js';
+import { stopsFrom } from '../render/train-stops.js';
+import type { Member } from './attendance-service.js';
+import type { GymProvider } from './gym-directory.js';
+
+const alice: Member = { id: ALICE, name: 'Alice' };
+
+/** A power spot in West, one in East, one in the region of the second server (North). */
+const WEST_SPOT = keptRow(901, {
+  kind: 'powerspot',
+  title: 'Gazebo of the Lake',
+  lat: 40.05,
+  lon: -80.05,
+});
+const EAST_SPOT = keptRow(902, {
+  kind: 'powerspot',
+  title: 'Harbor Anchor',
+  lat: 40.05,
+  lon: -79.95,
+});
+const NORTH_SPOT = keptRow(903, {
+  kind: 'powerspot',
+  title: 'Hill Gazebo',
+  lat: 40.25,
+  lon: -80.05,
+});
+const STOP = keptRow(904, { kind: 'stop', title: 'Bench', lat: 40.05, lon: -80.04 });
+
+async function spotted(route: readonly (number | ReturnType<typeof spotStop>)[] = [4, 1]) {
+  const kept = await wayspotsWith([WEST_SPOT, EAST_SPOT, NORTH_SPOT, STOP]);
+  const made = await createdTrain(
+    { route },
+    { wayspots: kept.wayspots, renderDelayMs: 0, sharedDelayMs: 0 },
+  );
+  return { ...made, ...kept };
+}
+
+describe('power spots as stops of a train (plan 8X-4; design 6.2)', () => {
+  it('reaches a power spot of a region of its server, and no other place', async () => {
+    const made = await spotted();
+    const party = made.current();
+    expect(made.trains.reaches(party, spotStop(WEST_SPOT.id))).toBe(true);
+    expect(made.trains.reaches(party, spotStop(EAST_SPOT.id))).toBe(true);
+    // Of another server's region, a PokéStop, and one Pine does not keep: none.
+    expect(made.trains.reaches(party, spotStop(NORTH_SPOT.id))).toBe(false);
+    expect(made.trains.reaches(party, spotStop(STOP.id))).toBe(false);
+    expect(made.trains.reaches(party, spotStop(keptRow(999).id))).toBe(false);
+    expect(made.trains.reaches(party, gym(4))).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('refuses a power spot that is gone by the time the stop is added', async () => {
+    const made = await spotted();
+    expect(await made.trains.addStop(made.party.id, alice, spotStop(keptRow(999).id))).toEqual({
+      kind: 'refused',
+      reason: 'spot-gone',
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('copies the post into the channel of the region a power spot of its route lies in', async () => {
+    const made = await spotted([4, spotStop(EAST_SPOT.id)]);
+    await made.service.flush();
+    const copies = made.gateway.messagesIn(EAST_CHANNEL).filter((sent) => sent.message.v2 === true);
+    expect(copies).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(textOf(copies[0]?.message)).toContain('Harbor Anchor');
+  });
+
+  it('takes off a power spot that an import found gone or made a PokéStop, as an unknown gym', async () => {
+    const made = await spotted([4, spotStop(WEST_SPOT.id), spotStop(EAST_SPOT.id)]);
+    await made.storage.saveFromImport(
+      { upsert: [{ ...EAST_SPOT, kind: 'stop' }], remove: [], gone: [WEST_SPOT.id] },
+      5_000,
+    );
+    await made.wayspots.load();
+    expect(await made.trains.removeUnknownStops()).toBe(1);
+    expect(made.current().train.route).toEqual([gym(4)]);
+    await made.attendance.flush();
+    expect(made.said().at(-1)).toBe(
+      "2 stops were removed: their power spots are no longer in Pine's list of power spots.",
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('takes off a power spot that is gone while the gym list is empty, and no gym', async () => {
+    // A gym list that knows no gym at all (it could not be read), though it still names them.
+    const empty = Object.defineProperty(Object.create(gymsFixture()) as GymProvider, 'size', {
+      value: 0,
+    });
+    const kept = await wayspotsWith([WEST_SPOT, EAST_SPOT]);
+    const made = await createdTrain(
+      { route: [4, spotStop(WEST_SPOT.id), 1] },
+      { wayspots: kept.wayspots, gyms: empty },
+    );
+    await kept.storage.saveFromImport({ upsert: [], remove: [], gone: [WEST_SPOT.id] }, 5_000);
+    await kept.wayspots.load();
+    expect(await made.trains.removeUnknownStops()).toBe(1);
+    expect(made.current().train.route).toEqual([gym(4), gym(1)]);
+  });
+
+  it('takes off no power spot while no Wayspot is kept at all', async () => {
+    const made = await spotted([4, spotStop(WEST_SPOT.id)]);
+    for (const id of [WEST_SPOT.id, EAST_SPOT.id, NORTH_SPOT.id, STOP.id]) {
+      made.wayspots.forget([id]);
+    }
+    expect(made.wayspots.size).toBe(0);
+    expect(await made.trains.removeUnknownStops()).toBe(0);
+    expect(made.current().train.route).toHaveLength(2);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps every id of the panel within what Discord takes with the longest Wayfarer ids', async () => {
+    // The longest Wayfarer id: 32 hexadecimal digits and three more.
+    const longest = (n: number) => `${'f'.repeat(31)}${n.toString(16)}.999`;
+    const ids = [1, 2, 3].map(longest);
+    const kept = await wayspotsWith(
+      ids.map((id, n) =>
+        keptRow(800 + n, {
+          id,
+          kind: 'powerspot',
+          title: `Spot ${n}`,
+          lat: 40.05,
+          lon: -80.05 + n / 1000,
+        }),
+      ),
+    );
+    const made = await createdTrain({ route: ids.map(spotStop) }, { wayspots: kept.wayspots });
+    const party = made.current();
+    const panel = trainPanel({
+      party,
+      stop: stopsFrom(made.gyms ?? { get: () => undefined }, kept.wayspots),
+    });
+    const all = [
+      ...customIdsOf(panel),
+      ...selectsOf(panel).map((menu) => menu.customId),
+      ...customIdsOf(made.gateway.posts.get(made.postId)?.message),
+    ];
+    expect(all.length).toBeGreaterThan(5);
+    for (const id of all) expect(id.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);
+  });
+});

### Task 5: 8X-4 task 4: saved routes of gyms and power spots

Prototype commit: `9817b94b522e074a613bb2e85b224e51ae015e51`

SavedRoute.gyms is stops: StopRef[]. The column SavedRoutes.gyms keeps
the stops by their keys, a gym by its id as the legacy bot wrote them, a
power spot as w<Wayfarer id> (routeText, routeStops; no migration: the
column is text and the legacy bot never reads a route the new bot
saved); the reader keeps both and leaves out what is none. removeGym
keeps a route's power spots and removes only a route left without any
stop; countWithGym and removeGym narrow the LIKE by the parsed stops, so a
Wayfarer id holding a gym's digits is no such gym. /route save keeps the
whole route; /route load leaves out gyms and power spots that are gone
or of no region of the server ("One stop of it no longer exists").

+import { gymStop, spotStop } from '../../domain/party/stops.js';
+import { routeStops, routeText } from './saved-route-repository.js';
+
+const SPOT = 'c0ffee00c0ffee00c0ffee00c0ffee00.16';
+
+describe('the stops of a saved route as the column holds them (plan 8X-4; design 6.2)', () => {
+  it('reads gym ids and power spots separated by commas, and leaves out what is none', () => {
+    expect(routeStops('12,45,9')).toEqual([gymStop(12), gymStop(45), gymStop(9)]);
+    expect(routeStops(`12,w${SPOT},9`)).toEqual([gymStop(12), spotStop(SPOT), gymStop(9)]);
+    expect(routeStops('')).toEqual([]);
+    expect(routeStops(null)).toEqual([]);
+    // What the legacy bot may have left: a gym twice, words, numbers that are no id.
+    expect(routeStops(' 3 , 3,4,x,1e3,99999999999999999999,0')).toEqual([gymStop(3), gymStop(4)]);
+    // A power spot twice counts once, one of no Wayfarer id is none.
+    expect(routeStops(`w${SPOT},wxyz,w${SPOT}`)).toEqual([spotStop(SPOT)]);
+  });
+
+  it('writes the stops by their keys, which it reads back as they were', () => {
+    const stops = [gymStop(4), spotStop(SPOT), gymStop(1)];
+    expect(routeText(stops)).toBe(`4,w${SPOT},1`);
+    expect(routeStops(routeText(stops))).toEqual(stops);
+    // A route of gyms is written as the legacy bot wrote it.
+    expect(routeText([gymStop(4), gymStop(1)])).toBe('4,1');
+  });
+});

### Task 6: 8X-4 task 5: power spots and train kinds in the party history, migration 026

Prototype commit: `2a7bccf7e2538649fb7120d30e172c89b7d6a955`

Migration 026 (2026_10_21_026_train_spot_stops): PartyHistoryStop.wayspotId
varchar(40) null and PartyHistory.trainKind varchar(10) null, each added
only when it is missing; src/db/types.ts regenerated (db:codegen). After
8X-3's 025; wayfarer's newest is 024.
A train at a power spot is a step of kind spot (subject the bare
Wayfarer id, value null), so a spot is no end of the route; trainStops
and the route's fallback (stopsByRoute over StopRefs) record a spot's
stop with its wayspotId and no gym. The legacy import keeps wayspotId
null. A train's record keeps its kind (HistoryRecord.trainKind: raid,
dynamax, gigantamax; a legacy train is raid), null for other parties;
026 sets the trains recorded before it to raid (they all were).
The questions' fixture has a train with a power spot stop: trains by
length counts it, the busiest gyms leave it out. history.md says so.

 Every party that ends is kept in relational tables beside the live `Party` table (plan 8H; spec `2026-10-16-cutover-docker-history-design.md`, 4.3): what it was, where and when, how it ended and how many took part, in a form that plain SQL counts and groups. The legacy bot's parties are imported once from its files. Members are named only with their opt-in. Read before changing the history, its recording, the opt-in or the import, or before writing a statistic over it.
 
-## The tables (migrations 018, 020 and 025)
+## The tables (migrations 018, 020, 025 and 026)
 
-- `PartyHistory`: one row per ended party. `source` is `live` (with `partyId`, the `Party.id`, unique) or `legacy` (with `legacyKey`, `<channel>:<creation ms>`, unique). `kind` is `raid`, `train`, `meetup` or `max` (a max battle, plan 8X-3). Where: `serverId` (the server's snowflake), `regionId`, `gymId`, `legacyGymId` (the legacy file's gym, kept also when the gym list no longer has it). None of them carries a foreign key: the history outlives a server's `Guild` row (a kick and a new invite neither delete it nor split it; Matt, 2026-10-16), and a region or gym deleted later stays named by its id. What: `name` and `description` (trains and meetups), `tier` (`T1` to `T5`, `Mega`, `MegaLegendary`, `SuperMega`, `Elite`, and the legacy `T2`, `T4`, `EX`; a max battle's `D1` to `D5` or `G`; null where not known), `shadow`, `mega`, `elite`, `ex`, `shiny` (null: not known), the boss as the catalogue knows it (`bossKey`, `bossDex`, `bossSpecies`, `bossForm`; a mega's form is `<SPECIES>_<MEGA…>`) or, where it does not, by the name it was given (`bossName`), `fastMove`, `chargedMove`. When (epoch ms): `createdAt`, `hatchTime`, `startTime` (trains and meetups), `endTime`, `endedAt` (null for the legacy parties of the cutover). How it ended: `ending` (below). Who: `createdById`, `conductorId`, only with that member's opt-in, else null; `anonymous` (the reporter asked not to be named in the post). Counts, so that the common questions need no join: `attendees` (members who signed up, also those who left), `interested`, `joined`, `here`, `done` (members by the furthest status they reached), the same with their +1s (`interestedHeads` …), `extras` (all +1s), `remote`, `departed` (left before the end, not by a split); `routeStops` (a train's route at the end); `splitFromId` (migration 020, below).

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e6071712e1902a60a5d5a0614eeac4371909a967
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/migrations/2026_10_21_026_train_spot_stops.db.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+import { sql, type Kysely } from 'kysely';
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { startMigratedDatabase } from '../../../test/support/migrated-db.js';
+import type { DB } from '../types.js';
+import { trainSpotStops } from './2026_10_21_026_train_spot_stops.js';
+
+const HOME = '412345678901234567';
+const TRAIN = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
+const MAX_TRAIN = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
+const RAID = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003';
+
+describe('migration 026: power spots as stops and the kind of a train in the history', () => {
+  let stop: () => Promise<void>;
+  let db: Kysely<DB>;
+
+  beforeAll(async () => {
+    ({ db, stop } = await startMigratedDatabase());
+  });
+  afterAll(async () => {
+    await stop();
+  });
+
+  const columns = async () => {
+    const rows = await sql<{ name: string; type: string; nullable: string }>`
+      select concat(table_name, '.', column_name) as name, column_type as type,
+             is_nullable as nullable
+      from information_schema.columns
+      where table_schema = database()
+        and ((table_name = 'PartyHistoryStop' and column_name = 'wayspotId')
+          or (table_name = 'PartyHistory' and column_name = 'trainKind'))
+      order by name`.execute(db);
+    return rows.rows;
+  };
+
+  it('adds PartyHistoryStop.wayspotId and PartyHistory.trainKind, both null by default', async () => {
+    expect(await columns()).toEqual([
+      { name: 'PartyHistory.trainKind', type: 'varchar(10)', nullable: 'YES' },
+      { name: 'PartyHistoryStop.wayspotId', type: 'varchar(40)', nullable: 'YES' },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('records the trains of before as raid trains, and no other party as a train', async () => {
+    // As 026 finds them: trains recorded before it had no kind.
+    await sql`insert into PartyHistory (source, partyId, kind, serverId, createdAt, ending)
+              values ('live', ${TRAIN}, 'train', ${HOME}, 900, 'completed'),
+                     ('live', ${RAID}, 'raid', ${HOME}, 950, 'completed')`.execute(db);
+    await sql`insert into PartyHistory (source, partyId, kind, serverId, createdAt, ending, trainKind)
+              values ('live', ${MAX_TRAIN}, 'train', ${HOME}, 1000, 'completed', 'gigantamax')`.execute(
+      db,
+    );
+    await trainSpotStops.up(db);
+    const rows = await sql<{ partyId: string; trainKind: string | null }>`
+      select partyId, trainKind from PartyHistory order by createdAt`.execute(db);
+    expect(rows.rows).toEqual([
+      { partyId: TRAIN, trainKind: 'raid' },
+      { partyId: RAID, trainKind: null },
+      { partyId: MAX_TRAIN, trainKind: 'gigantamax' },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('can run again: the columns are added only when they are missing', async () => {
+    await trainSpotStops.up(db);
+    expect(await columns()).toHaveLength(2);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/db/migrations/2026_10_21_026_train_spot_stops.ts b/src/db/migrations/2026_10_21_026_train_spot_stops.ts

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..608d75fd650e3f25a813cf81c36bd8447816721c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/db/migrations/2026_10_21_026_train_spot_stops.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+import { sql, type Kysely } from 'kysely';
+import type { Migration } from 'kysely/migration';
+
+/**
+ * Power spots as stops of a train in the party history (plan 8X-4; design
+ * `2026-10-20-max-battles-design.md`, 6.2, section 10): `PartyHistoryStop.wayspotId`, the Wayfarer
+ * id of a power spot the train stopped at (`varchar(40)`: an id is 35 or 36 characters), null for
+ * a gym's stop and for every stop before. No foreign key: a Wayspot an import deleted or made a
+ * gym stays named by its id, as a gym deleted later does. And `PartyHistory.trainKind`
+ * (`varchar(10)`): what a train went to, `raid`, `dynamax` or `gigantamax`; null for every party
+ * that is no train. The trains recorded before are set to `raid` (they all were: the kinds came
+ * with 8X-4); nothing else is changed.
+ *
+ * 026: after 8X-3's `025_max_battle_history` (the newest of `typescript-migration` on
+ * 2026-10-21; `wayfarer`'s newest is 024). A 026 of `wayfarer` merged first renumbers this one.
+ *
+ * Safe to run again after a failure half-way: each column is added only when it is missing, and
+ * the trains without a kind are set again (a train recorded since has its kind).
+ */
+export const trainSpotStops: Migration = {
+  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- migrations are schema-agnostic
+  async up(db: Kysely<any>) {
+    const existing = await sql<{ n: number }>`
+      select count(*) as n from information_schema.columns
+      where table_schema = database() and table_name = 'PartyHistoryStop'
+        and column_name = 'wayspotId'`.execute(db);
+    if (Number(existing.rows[0]?.n ?? 0) === 0) {
+      await sql`alter table PartyHistoryStop add column wayspotId varchar(40) null default null`.execute(
+        db,
+      );
+    }
+    const kind = await sql<{ n: number }>`
+      select count(*) as n from information_schema.columns
+      where table_schema = database() and table_name = 'PartyHistory'
+        and column_name = 'trainKind'`.execute(db);
+    if (Number(kind.rows[0]?.n ?? 0) === 0) {
+      await sql`alter table PartyHistory add column trainKind varchar(10) null default null`.execute(
+        db,
+      );
+    }
+    // The trains recorded before were raid trains, every one: the kinds came with 8X-4.
+    await sql`update PartyHistory set trainKind = 'raid'
+              where kind = 'train' and trainKind is null`.execute(db);
+  },
+  async down() {
+    // Additive only: the column stays.
+  },
+};

### Task 7: 8X-4 task 6: the pings of a group or a party in several messages

Prototype commit: `64825a9b6b98e511767dc821a83add231e5dc0d3`

Once a Gigantamax train holds a hundred, the pings that still went in one
message (about 86 members) go through pingInMessages, every member once,
in as many messages as it takes, none into the post of a party that has
ended or moved: a train's movement, a timed party's start, a group's
meeting time, the notice of a new group (its sentence and hint first),
the notice that a raid moved to another region, the split notice of a
train. pingInMessages also says how many messages it sent (the move
notice counts as said once its first message went). The archive warning
stays one message: its id is kept to delete it.

 8 files changed, 203 insertions(+), 49 deletions(-)

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..92d30995946034997660c90e7e4c4b1af1b9e04d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/services/pings-in-messages.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,128 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { ALICE, MINUTE, PARTY_NOW, REPORTER } from '../../test/support/parties.js';
+import { createdTrain, reportedRaid } from '../../test/support/party-service.js';
+import type { Party } from '../domain/party/party.js';
+import { PartyStatus } from '../domain/party/status.js';
+import type { Member } from './attendance-service.js';
+
+const alice: Member = { id: ALICE, name: 'Alice' };
+
+/** A crowd of this many members, by snowflakes of their own. */
+const crowd = (count: number): string[] =>
+  Array.from({ length: count }, (_, n) => `9${String(n).padStart(17, '0')}`);
+
+/** Everybody in a crowd signed up as coming, in group A, unless `group` says otherwise. */
+function withCrowd<P extends Party>(party: P, members: readonly string[], group = 'A'): P {
+  const attendees = { ...party.attendees };
+  for (const id of members) {
+    attendees[id] = { number: 1, status: PartyStatus.Coming, group: group as 'A', remote: false };
+  }
+  return { ...party, attendees };
+}
+
+type Gateway = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createdTrain>>['gateway'];
+
+/** Who the messages of a post pinged since `from` messages, and how many messages it took. */
+function pingedIn(gateway: Gateway, postId: string, from: number) {
+  const sent = gateway.messagesIn(postId).slice(from);
+  return {
+    messages: sent.filter((message) => (message.message.mention?.users ?? []).length > 0).length,
+    users: sent.flatMap((message) => message.message.mention?.users ?? []),
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Plan 8X-4 (follow-ups of 8X-1): a Gigantamax train holds a hundred, so the pings of a group or a
+ * party go in as many messages as it takes (`pingInMessages`), every member pinged once.
+ */
+describe('pings of a group or a party in as many messages as it takes (plan 8X-4)', () => {
+  const many = crowd(150);
+
+  it('pings everybody of a train that moves', async () => {
+    const made = await createdTrain({ route: [4, 1, 7], kind: 'gigantamax' });
+    await made.store.update(made.party.id, (party) => ({ party: withCrowd(party, many) }));
+    await made.attendance.signUp(made.party.id, alice, PartyStatus.Coming);
+    const before = made.gateway.messagesIn(made.postId).length;
+    await made.trains.move(made.party.id, alice, 'next', false);
+    await made.trains.flush();
+    const pinged = pingedIn(made.gateway, made.postId, before);
+    expect(new Set(pinged.users)).toEqual(new Set([REPORTER, ...many]));
+    expect(pinged.users).toHaveLength(many.length + 1);
+    expect(pinged.messages).toBeGreaterThan(1);
+  });
+
+  it('pings everybody of a train whose start is set', async () => {
+    const made = await createdTrain({ kind: 'gigantamax' });
+    await made.store.update(made.party.id, (party) => ({ party: withCrowd(party, many) }));
+    const before = made.gateway.messagesIn(made.postId).length;
+    await made.timed.setStartTime(made.party.id, { id: REPORTER }, PARTY_NOW + 60 * MINUTE);
+    await made.timed.flush();
+    const pinged = pingedIn(made.gateway, made.postId, before);
+    expect(new Set(pinged.users)).toEqual(new Set(many));
+    expect(pinged.users).toHaveLength(many.length);
+  });
+
+  it('pings everybody of a group whose meeting time is set, and of a group that is opened', async () => {
+    const made = await reportedRaid();
+    await made.store.update(made.party.id, (party) => ({ party: withCrowd(party, many) }));
+    const before = made.gateway.messagesIn(made.postId).length;
+    await made.attendance.setMeetingTime(made.party.id, { id: REPORTER }, PARTY_NOW + 30 * MINUTE);
+    await made.attendance.flush();
+    const met = pingedIn(made.gateway, made.postId, before);
+    expect(new Set(met.users)).toEqual(new Set(many));
+    expect(met.users).toHaveLength(many.length);
+    const opened = made.gateway.messagesIn(made.postId).length;
+    await made.attendance.newGroup(made.party.id, { id: REPORTER, name: 'Rae' });
+    await made.attendance.flush();
+    const grouped = pingedIn(made.gateway, made.postId, opened);
+    expect(new Set(grouped.users)).toEqual(new Set(many));
+  });
+
+  it('pings everybody of a raid that moves to another region', async () => {
+    const made = await reportedRaid();
+    await made.store.update(made.party.id, (party) => ({ party: withCrowd(party, many) }));
+    const before = made.gateway.messagesIn(made.postId).length;
+    // Gym 8 lies in East.
+    expect(await made.raids.setGym(made.party.id, { id: REPORTER }, 8)).toMatchObject({
+      kind: 'ok',
+    });
+    const pinged = pingedIn(made.gateway, made.postId, before);
+    expect(new Set(pinged.users)).toEqual(new Set(many));
+    expect(pinged.users).toHaveLength(many.length);
+  });
+
+  it('says once that a raid moved when Discord fails after its first message', async () => {
+    const made = await reportedRaid();
+    await made.store.update(made.party.id, (party) => ({ party: withCrowd(party, many) }));
+    const send = made.gateway.sendMessage.bind(made.gateway);
+    let sent = 0;
+    made.gateway.sendMessage = (channelId, message) => {
+      if (channelId === made.postId && ++sent === 2) {
+        return Promise.reject(new Error('Discord is down'));
+      }
+      return send(channelId, message);
+    };
+    // Gym 8 lies in East.
+    expect(await made.raids.setGym(made.party.id, { id: REPORTER }, 8)).toMatchObject({
+      kind: 'ok',
+    });
+    const said = made.gateway
+      .messagesIn(made.postId)
+      .filter((message) => message.message.content?.startsWith('This raid has moved to'));
+    expect(said).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+
+  it('pings everybody who went with a group split off a train', async () => {
+    const made = await createdTrain({ route: [4, 1], kind: 'gigantamax' });
+    await made.store.update(made.party.id, (party) => ({
+      party: { ...withCrowd(party, many, 'B'), groups: [{ id: 'A' }, { id: 'B' }] },
+    }));
+    const split = await made.trains.split(made.party.id, { id: REPORTER }, true, 'B');
+    expect(split.kind).toBe('split');
+    if (split.kind !== 'split') return;
+    const postId = split.party.forumPostId ?? '';
+    const pinged = pingedIn(made.gateway, postId, 0);
+    expect(new Set(pinged.users)).toEqual(new Set(many));
+    expect(pinged.users).toHaveLength(many.length);
+  });
+});

### Task 8: 8X-4 task 7: the map's trains with power spot stops

Prototype commit: `82290530b2cf4b6324bdda7524036373b3774df4`

MapTrain.route is the stops' keys (task 2) and MapTrain.spots the power
spots of the route that Pine keeps, with their names and places
(PartyViewInput.spotOf, the kept Wayspots): the line of a train, its
ring and route mode's numbers go through them, its popup names one
"<title> (power spot)" with Directions to it. A route edit's add body is
{ drawn, stop } by the stop's key (a gym's id or w<Wayfarer id>), what is
no key refused 400, a stop of no region of the server 404; the route
editor still adds the gyms clicked. Power spots as a layer, Add to route
from a spot and the panel's kind menu on the map are 8X-5's.

+/** A point on the map: a gym's, or a power spot's of a train's data. */
+export interface StopPlace {

+  lon: number;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Where a stop of a train's route is on the map: its gym's point as the map has it, a power
+ * spot's as the train's data gives it (`MapTrain.spots`), undefined for one the map cannot place.
+ */
+export function stopPlace(
+  train: Pick<MapTrain, 'spots'>,
+  key: string | undefined,
+  gyms: ReadonlyMap<number, StopPlace>,
+): StopPlace | undefined {
+  const gymId = gymOfStop(key);
+  if (gymId !== null) return gyms.get(gymId);
+  return train.spots.find((one) => one.key === key);

+
+/**
+ * How the map draws a train (plan 8S-4; plan 8X-4 for power spots): its line through the stops it

+export function trainPlaces(
+  train: Pick<MapTrain, 'route' | 'stop' | 'spots'>,
+  gyms: ReadonlyMap<number, StopPlace>,
+): { line: StopPlace[]; ring: { at: StopPlace; here: boolean } | undefined } {
+  const line = train.route.flatMap((key) => {

+    return place ? [place] : [];

+  const at = train.stop === null ? undefined : stopPlace(train, train.route[train.stop], gyms);
+  const first = line[0];
+  return {
+    line,
+    ring: at ? { at, here: true } : first ? { at: first, here: false } : undefined,
+  };

A member larger than a lobby by themself goes straight to the group with the most room (no new group would hold them either), and a party without groups (a meetup) keeps its one. `+1` and Remote sign a new member up the same way.  ## The model
 
-- A raid train is the third kind (`TrainParty`: `timed` like a meetup, and `train: { route, stop, conductorId, boss, finishedFrom, atEnd }`). `isTrain`, the guards `requireTrain` (with `commandTrain`, `trainOf`) and `requireRaidOrTrain` (what has a boss or a gym: `/boss`, `/where`); `bossOf(party)` is the boss of any party that has one. `route` is gym ids, none twice, at most `MAX_ROUTE_STOPS`; `stop === route.length` on a route that is not empty means finished; `party.gymId` is null (the gym of a train is `currentStop(party)`). It has groups like a raid and one start like a meetup; Done means leave, and whoever leaves as the conductor stops being it.
+- A raid train is the third kind (`TrainParty`: `timed` like a meetup, and `train: { route, stop, conductorId, boss, finishedFrom, atEnd }`). `isTrain`, the guards `requireTrain` (with `commandTrain`, `trainOf`) and `requireRaidOrTrain` (what has a boss or a gym: `/boss`, `/where`); `bossOf(party)` is the boss of any party that has one. `route` is stops (`StopRef`, plan 8X-4: a gym by its id or a power spot by its Wayfarer id; below), none twice, at most `MAX_ROUTE_STOPS`; `stop === route.length` on a route that is not empty means finished; `party.gymId` is null (the gym of a train is `currentStop(party)`). It has groups like a raid and one start like a meetup; Done means leave, and whoever leaves as the conductor stops being it.
 - The maker of a train is signed up as their auto-status says (None: not at all; Here counts as Coming), and with privacy Anonymous neither the post nor the new-train DM names them (`NewTrain.anonymous`, `autoStatus`). A maker who is not signed up may still arrange the route and the times as far as the train does not move (`mayArrange`, `party.ts`); moving it and being its conductor need a sign-up. Meetups know neither setting.
-- A train remembers the gym it was at when a move finished its route (`train.finishedFrom`; state document version 6, version 5 read as null): Previous from the end leads back there and leaves Here as Here (`destinationOf`, `targetOf`), and to the last stop when nothing is remembered. `withTrain` in `train.ts` is the one place that keeps it (null unless the route is finished and still has that gym), so a route is changed only through the functions of `train.ts`, never by building `train.route` by hand: the state document refuses a train that breaks the rule. The panel's Previous button carries its target like Next and Skip.
+- A train remembers the stop it was at when a move finished its route (`train.finishedFrom`; state document version 6, version 5 read as null): Previous from the end leads back there and leaves Here as Here (`destinationOf`, `targetOf`), and to the last stop when nothing is remembered. `withTrain` in `train.ts` is the one place that keeps it (null unless the route is finished and still has that stop), so a route is changed only through the functions of `train.ts`, never by building `train.route` by hand: the state document refuses a train that breaks the rule. The panel's Previous button carries its target like Next and Skip.
 
 ## Changes and movement
 
-- Everything that happens to a train is a pure function in `src/domain/party/train.ts` and goes through `ctx.trains` (`TrainService`: `addStop`, `removeStop`, `moveStop`, `clearRoute`, `move`, `reverse`, `setAtEnd`, `setConductor`, `clearConductor`, `setBoss`, `saveRoute`, `loadRoute`, `forgetRoute`, `savedRoutes`, `reaches`, `flush`; each change answers a `TrainChangeOutcome`). The current stop follows its gym through every route edit. An edit after which the train is somewhere else (`placeOf` differs: the current stop removed, a stop added to a finished route, a loaded route) is a movement: it needs the right to move (`mayNotMove`: the conductor or staff when there is a conductor, otherwise signed up; staff always), puts Here back to Coming and is announced. The first stop of an empty route is an ordinary edit. Finishing leaves Here as Here and changes no time.

An edit after which the train is somewhere else (`placeOf` differs: the current stop removed, a stop added to a finished route, a loaded route) is a movement: it needs the right to move (`mayNotMove`: the conductor or staff when there is a conductor, otherwise signed up; staff always), puts Here back to Coming and is announced. The first stop of an empty route is an ordinary edit. Finishing leaves Here as Here and changes no time.
 - Who may edit is one rule each in `train.ts`, which the domain functions, the live map's view and its routes all ask: `mayNotArrange` (add, remove, move a stop: signed up, the maker, staff), `mayNotClear` (the conductor and staff; `/route clear` counts bot developers as staff), `mayNotLoad` (who may move the train, or the maker its first route), `mayNotMove`. An edit of the route may carry the route it was drawn from (`drawn`, the live map's route editor: `addStop`, `removeStop`, `moveStop`, `clearRoute`, `loadRoute` and `saveRoute` take it last): the service refuses it inside the store when the route is another by now (`routeDrawn`, reason `route-edited`); a command gives none. So may a change of the conductor carry whose the role was as the map drew its button (`seen`, `ConductorSeen`: `setConductor` and `clearConductor` take it last), refused inside the store when the role is somebody else's by now (`conductorDrawn`, reason `conductor-changed`).
 - What the commands do beyond reading their options is one function each in `src/commands/trains/train-changes.ts` (`startTrainAs` for `/train`, `addStopAs` … `forgetRouteAs` for `/route`, `moveTrainAs` for the four moves, `setConductorAs`, `clearConductorAs`; `reverseRouteAs` and `setAtEndAs` word the panel's Reverse and mode for the map), answering a `TrainAnswer` in the command's words; the commands throw a refusal as a `UserError`, the live map answers it (plan 8M-5). The post's panel keeps its own answer, drawing itself anew. `startTrainAs` makes the train with its start when one is given (the map's form: `TrainRequest.startTime`, `NewTimedParty.startTime`), so that its post and the new-train DM say it from the first; `notSignedUpWords(where)` is the clause `/train` and the map add for a maker not signed up. `setConductorAs` names the conductor it took over from by the caller's `ConductorNamer` (`DISCORD_CONDUCTOR`, `memberText`, on Discord; the map names nobody).
-- A movement is announced in one message that pings the signed-up members who allow `mentions` and `mentionsTrainStops`, never the mover, gathered for five seconds and worded by the gym the train started from and where it is when the message goes ("back" only when every step was Previous; nothing when it is where it started or the route was emptied; "going round again, back to …" or "turning back at …, on to …" when the last step went round the end or turned back and the train is where it took it: `Movement` kinds `round` and `turn`, `PendingMove.lastFrom`). A gym is a stop only when it lies in a region of the train's server (`reaches`).
+- A movement is announced in one message that pings the signed-up members who allow `mentions` and `mentionsTrainStops`, never the mover, gathered for five seconds and worded by the gym the train started from and where it is when the message goes ("back" only when every step was Previous; nothing when it is where it started or the route was emptied; "going round again, back to …" or "turning back at …, on to …" when the last step went round the end or turned back and the train is where it took it: `Movement` kinds `round` and `turn`, `PendingMove.lastFrom`). A gym or a power spot is a stop only when it lies in a region of the train's server (`reaches`, `stopRegionsInGuild`).
 - What is said once a few seconds after the last change goes through `Gathered` (`src/services/gathered.ts`: `later(key, merge)`, `drop`, `flush`, with `fold(older, newer)` for an entry whose turn comes while another waits behind a slow send): the start of a timed party and a train's movement. The party services share `storedChange` (`src/services/party-change.ts`) for a change decided inside the store.
 - What a train does at the last stop of its route is `train.atEnd` (`TRAIN_AT_END`: `finish`, `loop`, `turn-back`; `TrainAtEnd`, `isTrainAtEnd` in `party.ts`), set by `/train`'s option `at-end` (default `finish`), the panel's menu (the menu is only in the panel, which opens only for who may move the train, so `setAtEnd`'s `mayArrange` matters for a panel opened earlier and for saved routes; `setAtEnd`: for whoever may arrange the route, `mayArrange`, and staff, since it never moves the train nor un-finishes a route; the same mode is the same object; the line names the doer through `doer`) and a loaded saved route. A route of fewer than two stops finishes in every mode (`endMode`). `destinationOf(party, move)` is where a move leaves the train (`route`, `stop`, `turn`, `skipped`): Next at the last stop finishes, goes to stop 0 (`turn: 'round'`) or stores the route reversed and goes to its index 1 (`turn: 'back'`); Skip goes round a loop (`(stop + 2) mod n`, three stops or more) and at the last stop of a turn-back to index 2 of the reversed route (refused at its second to last stop); Previous at stop 0 of a loop goes to the last stop, of the others is refused. A move that goes round or turns back is a movement and never finishes the route, and neither does removing the current last stop of a loop or turn-back train with two stops or more left (`removeStop`: a loop goes to stop 0, a turn-back train has the rest reversed and stands at its index 0); Finish finishes in every mode. `nextStop` and `turnAhead` say what Next does from where the train is. `reverseRoute(party, member, staff, from?, first?)` (`cannotReverse`: a loop at any stop, a route that finishes at its first or last stop; a finished route of either mode only when finished from its last stop, which starts it again there, else `reverse-finished-elsewhere`; never a turn-back or a route of one stop) puts the same gyms in the other order with the train at the same gym: no movement, Here stays Here, the mode stays, said in a line without a ping ("…, and starts again at X" for a restart). Reverse leaves `placeOf` as it was (except the restart of a finished route, which moves it from `end` to the gym), so the panel's control also carries `first`, the gym the route began with (`route-changed` otherwise). The post's line of what lies ahead says the mode on a route of three stops or fewer (`, loops` / `, turns back at the end`, on two stops or more) and marks a stop past the end `(round again)` / `(turning back)`; after a turn or a Reverse the stops are numbered in their stored order. The words of the modes are `src/render/train-words.ts`.

+## Kinds and power spots (plan 8X-4)
+
+- **The kind** (design `2026-10-20-max-battles-design.md`, 6.1): `train.kind` (`TrainKind`, which is `BattleKind`: `raid`, `dynamax`, `gigantamax`; party state version 14, a train of an older document is `raid`), set by `/train kind:` (default raid) and the Manage train panel's menu "What the train goes to" under the mode's (`party:<id>:kind`, `pressKind`, `TrainService.setKind`, `setTrainKind`: for who may move the train and staff; the same kind is no change; a line `<doer> made this a Gigantamax Train.`). Its words are one set, `TRAIN_KIND_WORDS` (`Raid Train`, `Max Battle Train`, `Gigantamax Train`; `trainKindChoice` for the choices): the post's heading and brief, `/help`, the panel; the new-train DM and the summary line name a max train's kind, a raid train's stays "train". It sets the lobby (`lobbySize`: a Gigantamax train `lobbies.gigantamax`, so Join fills its groups; a raid and a Dynamax train none; `splitLobby` only a raid train), at once when changed (groups already made stay), the forum tag (a Dynamax or Gigantamax train is tagged `Max battle` too) and `/counters` in its post (a Dynamax train the max counters at the boss's Dynamax tier where a max boss list names it, else `tier:` is asked; a Gigantamax train the Gigantamax tier; a raid train raid counters as before). `/boss` takes any Pokémon whatever the kind (`trainBoss`).
+- **Planned ahead:** `/train start:` (a time as `/meet` reads it, `typedTimedTime` over `newPartyTimes('train', now)`, read by the guard first so that a refusal is not counted) makes the train with its start; its route may stay empty until the day (a train with no time still goes a day after it was made). The Manage train panel opens on a train without a route too, with what applies: no moves, no Reverse, no mode, the kind menu (so a kind set wrongly at `/train` can be changed before the first stop).
+- **Stops** (design 6.2; `src/domain/party/stops.ts`): `StopRef` is `{ kind: 'gym', id }` or `{ kind: 'powerspot', id }` (a Wayfarer id); `stopKey` names one as text (`'12'`, `'w<Wayfarer id>'`: no colon, not `p`), by which stops are the same (`sameStop`, `whereOf` for whether a change moved the train) and the map's `MapTrain.route` is made; `stopHandle` is what a control carries (a gym's id; the first 8 hex characters of an FNV-1a hash of a Wayfarer id, so the panel's ids stay within 100 characters with the longest ids, tested), checked against the route when pressed (`stopsByHandle`: no match is `train-moved-on` for a place, two `route-changed`). Every function of `train.ts` works on stops. A power spot is shown as a gym stop (`src/render/train-stops.ts`: `PostStop`, `stopsFrom` over the gyms and the kept Wayspots, `stopLabel` `<title> (power spot)` in lists, the panel and the movement announcement, `stopLink`, `stopWhere`: Where with its address, Map and Wayfarer picture); one no longer kept as a power spot (gone, or an import made it a PokéStop or gym: a train's spot never becomes a stop of another kind) is `Unknown power spot`, refused when added (`spot-gone`) and taken off by `removeUnknownStops` as an unknown gym is (never while no Wayspot is kept, `WayspotProvider.size`). `/where` in a train at a spot names it with its Map; a gym target, a request and the moderators' place are of gyms (a spot is the moderators' place too).
+- **`/route add stop:`** (renamed from `gym:`): its list is the `PlaceFinder`'s of kinds `gym` and `powerspot`, each choice by its kind and where it is (`placeLabel`), a Dynamax or Gigantamax train offered power spots first among places that fit as well, a raid train gyms (`mergePlaces`' `kindsFirst`; a better fit first whatever its kind); with nothing typed the region's gyms as before, a max train's the region's power spots by name ahead of them. A value is `gym:<id>` or `powerspot:<Wayfarer id>` (an old `g:<id>` still read); typed text is a gym by `reportedGym`'s rule and a power spot by `clearOf`'s, and the train's own kind decides first (`typedStop`): its stop beyond doubt is taken, unless the other kind's stop beyond doubt fits the typed text strictly better (`PlaceFit`; design 6.2: a better match first, whatever its kind; a gym beyond doubt fits at least as a word's fit; a tie is the train's kind's), so a raid train finds gyms as before unless a power spot fits strictly better; its several (some fitting every word) are "Several places fit"; without one, or with a list of guesses only (no place of that kind of the server has every word as typed; for gyms, no gym of the server has every word as typed), the other kind's stop beyond doubt, else several or none. A raid train may add power spots. `/route remove stop:` keeps its stop number.
+- **Saved routes** keep stops: `SavedRoute.stops`, the column `SavedRoutes.gyms` their keys separated by commas (`routeText`, `routeStops`, which also reads the legacy bot's gym ids; no migration). `removeGym` keeps a route's power spots and removes only a route left without a stop; `countWithGym` and `removeGym` narrow their `LIKE` by the parsed stops. `/route load` leaves out stops gone or of no region of the server.
+- **Copies** in other regions go also where a power spot of the route lies (`stopRegionsInGuild` in `PartyMirrors.regionChannels`). The history records a spot's stop with its `wayspotId` (`history.md`). The map draws the line through the spots its data gives (`web.md`).

 - `/find-gym` and `/request` read a gym of this server through `src/commands/util/server-gym.ts` (`#n`, bare digits only when a gym of this server has that number or is called by them, a picked choice, or a clear hit; another server's gym reads as none). -- Pokebattler is `ctx.pokebattler` (`PokebattlerFight`, `src/services/pokebattler-gateway.ts`: ten seconds, 5 MB read by `readLimitedJson`, two requests at once, identical requests shared, answers kept ten minutes, a Pokébox never, the next boss name tried on 400/404 or an empty answer). `counters` asks for a raid simulation, `maxTeam` (plan 8X-6) for a max battle team (`GET /max/parties/suggested/defenders/<boss>/levels/<tier>?attack=&heal=&shield=&charge=&meterCharge=&level=&weatherCondition=&friendLevel=`, `maxTeamPath`; not among Pokebattler's documented endpoints, www.pokebattler.com/developers, so it may change without notice; a 400 or 404 there is read as a boss it does not know, but may also be parameters it refuses, for staging to tell apart): both through the same turns, limits and pause (no answer for one pauses both), each kind with its own cache. What a raid tier and a boss are called there, the option tables and the reading of the answer are pure (`src/domain/counters/`). Nominatim is `ctx.places` (`NominatimSearch`, `src/services/place-search.ts`: one request a second for the whole bot, ten waiting, a ten-minute pause after 429/403 also for searches already waiting, the place most likely meant kept a day; the search text is never logged). Of several places by one name `bestPlace` (`src/domain/geo/nominatim.ts`) takes a settlement or boundary before anything else and anything before a road, then the largest; a name is searched in the regions' box widened by `SEARCH_MARGIN_KM` (`widenedBox`); `settings.findRegion` (address and User-Agent) enables `/find-region`. Which regions a place touches is `shapeTouches` (`packages/wayspot-core/src/shape.ts`: the sides' sweep first, then one point each way). `ctx.maps.place` draws a place with regions; place pictures unused for a day are pruned by the hourly upkeep (`ImageCache.removeOlder`). Outside JSON bodies are read with `readLimitedJson` (a byte cap counted while reading). `/counters` for max battles (plan 8X-6; design section 8) is a max tier of `tier:` (D1 to D5, G, after the raid tiers) or the post of a max battle (its boss and tier, as a raid's post gives its own; a boss named there is taken in its tier), or a boss named without a tier that is no raid boss now and is a max boss (`currentMaxBoss`: the most stars, Gigantamax last; for a species a listed form of it, which is then the boss). "Gigantamax X" and "Dynamax X" are read as `/max` reads them. Gigantamax is refused, in the guard, for a Pokémon the game master has neither itself nor any form of as Gigantamax, unless it is on the max boss list at G (Pokebattler's feed may be ahead of the game data) or the post is of its own Gigantamax battle (another boss named there is not: `ownBattle`); in a train's post no max battle tier is guessed (a boss that is no raid boss now is asked for `tier:`, as before 8X-6; 8X-4 gives trains a kind), and its boss moves are offered; a species is asked under its own Gigantamax name and those of its forms that Gigantamax (`gigantamaxDefenders`: Toxtricity and both its forms, Urshifu only its forms). It shows Pokebattler's suggested team of three for the member's `role:`, one table (`MAX_ROLES`, `src/domain/counters/max-team.ts`; Matt, 2026-10-21, "a good starting point"): Attackers + charger 2/1/0/0 (attack/meterCharge/shield/heal; the default, Matt's usual team), Balanced 1/1/1/0, All attackers 3/0/0/0, Shielder 1/0/2/0, Healer 1/0/0/2, `charge` (Pokebattler's defender) 0 in all; every count is sent, and Pokebattler refuses a team that is not three. Every role but Balanced has a recorded answer in the tests (`uxie-d5-2-1-0-0` the default's). Levels are `MAX_TEAM_LEVELS`, 20 to 50 in steps of five (no best buddy levels: one Pokémon at a time is a best buddy; Matt), 40 unless named; weather and friendship as the raid's (the endpoint reads `weatherCondition` and `friendLevel`, probed live on 2026-10-21; friendship 0 without it); `moveset`, `shadow`, `mega`, `single` and the Pokébox level are refused in words for a max tier (`readMaxPlan`, in the guard, uncounted), `role` for a raid. The boss's names there are `pokebattlerMaxDefenders` (a Gigantamax boss as the feed writes it, `MACHAMP_GIGANTAMAX`, `TOXTRICITY_AMPED_GIGANTAMAX`; a mega has none and is refused); the answer is read by `readMaxTeam` (zod; `MOVE_NONE` is no charged move: the max moves are the point; the first three slots that fit, `MAX_TEAM_SIZE`, the rest counted as left out) and its Pokémon named as the max boss feed is mapped (`maxTeamMember`, `maxBossOf`: `RILLABOOM_GIGANTAMAX` is Gigantamax Rillaboom, pictured by `maxBossPicture`; one the game data does not know by Pokebattler's name in words, logged). The answer (`renderMaxTeam`, `src/render/max-team.ts`; `src/commands/util/max-counters.ts`) is in the counters' form: the boss, its types and the role beside its picture, each of the three with its role (`slotRoleWords`, Pokebattler's page's words: `ATTACK` Attacker, `METER_CHARGE` Charger, `SHIELD` Shielder, `HEAL` Healer, `CHARGE` Defender) and moves beside its picture, the first `SHOWN_ALTERNATIVES` (five) alternatives once per role (Pokebattler gives the slots of one role the same ten; "Others" for a role Pine does not know), the lines sharing what is left of `TEXT_BUDGET` equally, each fitted with "…and N more", the level the answer used, the weather and friendship and the max move levels in small print, "Change options…" (its dialog: role, level, weather, friendship; the kept options `KeptMaxCounters`, `kind: 'max'`, in the same `keptCounters` under the same custom-id kind), and "Full results", the role's page of Pokebattler's site (`maxTeamLink`: All attackers `/max/<boss>`, a team with a charger `/METER_CHARGE`, Shielder `/TANK`, Healer `/TOTAL_HEAL`; `/CHARGER` is the defenders' and `/PARTY` a lobby of four, no role's). No trainers estimate. The raid answer's "Full results" is the boss's page of the new site (`counterSiteLink`: `/raids/<boss>`, with `includeShadow=0` and `includeMegas=0` where the answer left them out; the site sends the API's long path there, dropping every option). A command that defers publicly in a party's post (`/counters`) reads the party again before it answers and answers privately when the party has ended meanwhile: an edit in an archived post opens it again. The answer of `/counters` is a components-v2 message (`renderCounters`, `src/render/counters.ts`; plan 8B-2): the boss, its raid and moves and the trainers beside its picture, the twelve counters with their moves' type emoji in small print, what the simulation was for in small print (never the member's Pokebattler user number), "Change options…" and the full results. Its options are kept a day (`keptCounters`, `KeptCounterOptions`: at most `COUNTERS_KEPT_MAX`, in memory, without the Pokébox number) under a token, the custom-id kind `counters` (`counters:<token>:options`, the dialog `counters:<token>:dialog`; `src/commands/util/counters-dialog.ts`): the dialog has five labels (attackers with the presser's Pokébox when they have an id, weather, friendship, boss moves of at most 25, "Also list" as a checkbox group); a submit builds the plan from the kept one (boss and tier never change), runs the command's `askPokebattler` and `answeredMessage` (a raid's counters or a max battle's team, by the kept options' `kind`; a new token; the old one stays good) and answers by `pressAnswer` (a Pokébox only privately); a token that is gone says "These options are no longer kept." A submit counts in the window of the command (above), opening the dialog in its own `MEMBER_READ_THROTTLE` window, and the guard `requireDialogPlan` refuses what does not fit before it is counted.

 ## Trains on the map (plan 8M-5)
 
 - **One code path per command** (spec 3.5, 3.7): what `/train`, the `/route` subcommands, `/next`, `/previous`, `/skip`, `/finish` and `/conductor` do beyond reading their options is one function each in `src/commands/trains/train-changes.ts` (`startTrainAs`, `addStopAs`, `removeStopAs`, `moveStopAs`, `clearRouteAs`, `saveRouteAs`, `loadRouteAs`, `forgetRouteAs`, `moveTrainAs`, `setConductorAs`, `clearConductorAs`; `TrainAnswer`: `ok`, `refused` with the service's reason, `gone`), in the command's words; the commands throw a refusal as a `UserError` and reply with the text, the map answers them. The panel of the post keeps its own answer (it draws itself anew); the map calls the same service methods with the same `from`, `target` and `first`, and words Reverse and the mode with `reverseRouteAs` and `setAtEndAs`. The web server is given what the commands read and call (`TrainWebDeps.ctx`, `TrainWebContext`: the bot's context in `src/app.ts`) and the channel names the bot sees (`channelName`).
-- **The view:** `MapTrain` (`party-data.ts`) carries, besides 8M-3's name, start, route and stop, what the member may do on the map, decided by the domain's own rules (`party-view.ts`, pure): `may` (`trainRights`: `arrange`, add, remove and move stops, `mayNotArrange`; `clear`, the conductor and staff, staff here as `/route clear` has it, bot developers included, `PartyViewInput.botStaff`, `isMapBotStaff`; `load`, `mayNotLoad`: who may move the train, or the maker its first route), `panel` (`trainPanelOf`: as the post's "Manage train…" opens it, none for who may not move the train, a train without a route, or while read-only; where the train is, `placeOf`; the moves `cannotMove` allows, each with where it leads, `targetOf`; the gym the route begins with where `cannotReverse` allows Reverse; the mode) and `conductor` (`conductorOf`: `you`, `other` or none, never a name; `mayTake` for a member signed up who is not it, `mayDrop` for the conductor and staff). The route is the version of the route (below). Nothing of it while read-only.

The route is the version of the route (below). Nothing of it while read-only.
 - **Starting a train** `POST /s/<guild>/api/trains`, body `{ region, name, time?, atEnd? }` (strict: any region of the server by id, as `/api/geo` lists it; the name up to `/train`'s 80 characters, blanks allowed so that they are refused in its words; the start as `/meet` takes it, up to 40; the mode as `/train`'s `at-end`). Before the body is read (`onRequest`): 60 a minute per address (`TRAIN_WRITES_PER_ADDRESS_MINUTE`, shared by every write of trains) and `postGuard`. Then the session (403) and the body (400); who starts it (`actingOnTheMap`); the region (of this server, else 404, whatever the id); its forum (none: 422 in `/train`'s words, the region named `#name`, `Region <id>` without a channel; `barred` 403; Discord unreachable 503); what `/train`'s guard and `/meet`'s reader refuse (a blank name 422 "Give a name of 1 to 80 characters."; a time that is none, read by `typedTimedTime` over `newPartyTimes('train', now)`, a party not made yet, 422 in its words); only then `/train`'s throttle in its window; then `startTrainAs` as the member (privacy and automatic status as `/train`), the train made with its start (`TrainRequest.startTime`, `NewTimedParty.startTime`, floored to the minute as `/meet` floors it), so that its post and the DM of who asked to hear of new trains say it from the first. The answer (`TrainAnswer`): 200 `{ ok: true, text: "Your train is made. It starts at 6:15 PM. Click gyms on the map to add its stops.", train }`, and for a maker who is not signed up (automatic status None) `/train`'s clause after it (`notSignedUpWords`: "You are not signed up for it, as your /settings auto-status is None: sign up in its popup or its post to move the train or to be its conductor."); a region that lost its forum meanwhile 422. Logged `{ user, guild, region, outcome }`, "a train was started on the map".
-- **The route** `POST /s/<guild>/api/trains/<id>/route/<edit>`, edit `add` (`{ drawn, gym }`), `remove` (`{ drawn, stop }`), `move` (`{ drawn, from, to }`), `clear` (`{ drawn }`), `save` (`{ drawn, name }`), `load` (`{ drawn, route }`), `forget` (`{ route }`): stops by their numbers from 1, as `/route` takes them; a saved route by the id the list gave it. **The version of the route** is the route itself: every edit but `forget` carries the route it was drawn from (`drawn`, the train's `route` as the page had it), and `TrainService` refuses it inside the store when the route is another by now (`routeDrawn`, reason `route-edited`, "The route changed meanwhile: here it is as it is now.", 409 with the train as it is now; a save is checked against the store's train before it writes); the commands give none, so they work as before. The order: the per-address limit, `postGuard` and an edit the map knows (404) before the body; the session and the body; who edits; an active train of this server as the store has it (anything else, a meetup's id among them, 409 "This train is over.", never read from the database); its forum (`barred` 403, unreachable 503); who may (`mayNotArrange` for add, remove and move, `mayNotClear` for clear, `mayNotLoad` for load: 403 in the command's words, "You are not signed up for this train.", with the train as the member sees it, who has passed its forum's access, so that the page draws the editor or the panel again without the controls); a gym of a region of this server (`reaches`; any other id 404, so nobody learns of other servers' gyms); only then the subcommand's throttle in its window (`route add`, … `CHANGE_THROTTLE`); then its code path. 200 `ok`, 409 for `gone` and a press that no longer fits (`route-edited`, `route-changed`, `train-moved-on`, `conductor-changed`), 422 for any other refusal (`MAX_ROUTE_STOPS`, a gym on the route already, a saved route the member does not have); every answer of who may and of the code path but `gone` carries the train as the member sees it now (the 403 of who may too). The member's saved routes of the train's region `GET /s/<guild>/api/trains/<id>/routes` (members, as the pick lists; an active train of this server, 409 otherwise; its forum, 403, 503; 30 a minute per address): `{ routes: [{ id, name, stops, atEnd }] }`, as `/route load`'s list offers them. Logged `{ user, guild, party, edit, outcome }`, "a train's route was changed on the map", never a name.

 - **Moving** `POST /s/<guild>/api/trains/<id>/move/<press>`, press `next`, `previous`, `skip` (`{ from, target }`), `finish` (`{ from }`), `reverse` (`{ from, first }`), `at-end` (`{ from, atEnd }`): the Manage train panel, each press carrying where the panel was drawn and where it leads, as the post's controls carry them; the same checks in the same order, who may being `mayNotMove` (the mode: `mayNotArrange`, as `setAtEnd` decides), and the window of the post's controls (`ACTION_THROTTLE`, `controlThrottleKey(PARTY_KIND)`), as a press of the panel counts; then `moveTrainAs` (the command's words, where the train is now, "I am telling the others."), `reverseRouteAs` ("The route is reversed. " and where the train is), `setAtEndAs` (`atEndSentence`). The movement message in the post pings as for any move. Logged "a train was moved on the map". **The conductor** `POST …/conductor/take` and `…/give-up` (body `{ who }`: `none`, `other` or `you`, whose the role was as the page drew the button, `CONDUCTOR_SEEN`): `/conductor set` and `/conductor clear` (`setConductorAs`, `clearConductorAs`); after the checks of every write, a button drawn when the role was another's than it is now 409 "The conductor of this train changed meanwhile: here it is as it is now." with the train (checked by the route against the store's train, not counted, and again inside the store, `conductorDrawn`, reason `conductor-changed`, for a change that was on its way meanwhile: `setConductorAs` and `clearConductorAs` pass `who` to the service), then a sign-up to take the role, the conductor or staff to drop it (403 in their words, with the train), in their windows. A takeover names nobody: "…, in the place of the conductor before." (`setConductorAs` takes a `ConductorNamer`; `/conductor set` passes `DISCORD_CONDUCTOR`, `memberText`). Logged "a train's conductor was changed on the map".
 - **Words:** `pageWords` also writes the bot's masked links as their text (`whereText` links every stop), read in the same one pass from the left as escapes and markdown, so that a bracket a member escaped begins no link.
 - **The page** (`src/web/client/train-forms.ts`, pure: the start form and its body, a train's actions, the route editor and the bodies of its edits, the Manage train panel and the body of a press, reading an answer, `sendTrainForm` over `pressParty`; the DOM side `train-ui.ts`): for a member while the map is not read-only, "New train" in a box at the top of the side panel (`#parties`, now shown for such a member also without parties) opens the start form there (name, region from `/api/geo`, start, mode); a train's popup (and its item in the side panel, where trains the map cannot draw are listed: no route yet, or none of its gyms on the map) gains `trainActions`: "Edit route" (`may.arrange`), "Manage…" (`panel`), "Be the conductor", "Stop being the conductor" or "Take the conductor off", and "You are its conductor." / "It has a conductor.". **Route mode** ("Edit route", and at once after a new train is made by who may arrange it): the route editor in the side panel box (the stops numbered as stored, the train's marked; for who may arrange it (`may.arrange`) up, down, a "move to" list of every position (one `/route move`, so that a stop goes far in one edit) and remove per stop, rather than dragging; "Clear the route" for who may; the saved routes to load or forget; a name to save the route under; Done), the stops numbered on the map over a dashed line (`routeMarkers`; a `divIcon` whose `html` is an element of ours with the number as text, never a string), and a gym clicked (or Enter on a focused one), its dot or the marker of its raids, added as the next stop without its popup opening: Leaflet opens a bound popup before any handler of ours, so the gyms' layers have Leaflet's click and keypress handlers taken off and open their popup from ours, which in route mode adds the stop instead (`gymClicks`, `gymClicked`); a gym on the route already is said under the editor ("The Stacks is on the route already.", `routeEditBody`) and nothing is sent, and a double click whose clicks route mode took does not zoom the map. The edits run one at a time (`RouteEdits`): a gym clicked while an edit is on its way waits for its turn, its body made from the train the answer before gave (so quick clicks do not refuse each other as `route-edited` and burn the throttle), and the editor's controls but Done are off meanwhile; each answer redraws the editor and the numbers from the train it gives, also after a 409; an answer that the train is gone (409 without a train, `routeModeEnds`) ends route mode, any other without a train (429, 503, a broken connection) is said and changes nothing. **The panel** ("Manage…") opens in the train's popup in place of its actions: where the train is, the moves with their targets, "Reverse the route", the mode with Set, Done; it stays open after a move, as the post's does, drawn anew from the answer's train with the words under it, also after a press that no longer fits; the list is asked for again after each move and drawn once the panel or its popup closes; Done draws the map with the train's popup open again, and so does a move after which the member may move it no more (no panel, also the 403 of who may, which carries the train); an answer that the train is gone (409 without a train, `routeModeEnds`) closes the panel, says it and draws the map with nothing opened. The conductor's buttons press at once with `conductorBody`. One form or mode at a time (`FormHold`, shared with the raid and spawn forms: route mode and the start form take it as forms of the trains' box (`take(false, true)`, `aside`), the panel as one of a popup or a side panel item; `formControls` also turns "New train", "Edit route" and "Manage…" off). The list waits under a form, but for one of the trains' box, which a redraw of the side panel keeps in place (`keepTools`: a box already first is not taken out, only what follows it, so a field of the start form or the route editor keeps the focus); the route editor, drawn anew from each answer, keeps the name typed to save under and the saved route picked (`RouteEditorFilled`; the name is emptied once the route is saved): under route mode and the start form the list is drawn (the controls that open another form turned off again after each draw), and the line of the train being routed is left to route mode's numbers (`drawnTrains`), the other trains' lines and markers drawn `interactive: false` meanwhile (`clickable`), so that a gym under them stays a stop to click; as route mode starts and ends, the list the page has is drawn anew at once (`TrainUiDeps.redrawn`; the poller draws only a list that changed), so that the train's own line leaves the map with "Edit route" and comes back with Done.
